Je cherche un vélo pliant pour le train et deux étages sans ascenseur. Quels modèles regarder avec 1 200 € maximum ?
Compare le Tenways CGO600 et le Rockrider E-ACTV 100 à partir des fiches vérifiées, en confirmant les variantes.
interface.longDescription:
VéloRepère helps French-speaking users in France find and compare bikes for their use, budget and terrain. Start with a city-bike budget, a commute with hills, or the need to carry a folding bike between train and stairs. The service can return a provisional selection when some criteria are still unknown, ask relevant follow-up questions, look up named models and compare identified variants.

Recommendations use only the validated catalog, not every bike on the market. Results explain reasons and trade-offs, show verification dates and confidence, and explicitly identify missing data. A named model or exact variant may be absent or require clarification; the service does not invent a match. Buying guides explain practical criteria such as brakes, batteries and maintenance before purchase.

Prices are dated observations, not guaranteed live prices. VéloRepère does not provide real-time stock, exhaustive merchant-price comparison, second-hand listings, route navigation, repair bookings, financial advice or payment. No VéloRepère account is required. Product links lead to detailed pages on velorepere.fr; any merchant or affiliate links remain on those pages and are labeled there.
